input: organising sunday lunch at home in salt lake, kolkata for 8 — parents, in-laws, kids. thakuma's favourite is singi macher jhol and ma is cooking. need ~1.5 kg singi cleaned and cut into jhol pieces, head kept, no cutting work at home. must reach salt lake by 10:30 am sunday, under ₹2000 incl delivery. it has to be the freshest you can get, like baba used to bring straight from the bazaar on sundays — proper singi like they sell at maniktala, not some frozen packet stuff. freshness is everything for jhol, thakuma will definately notice. can you place the order?

experiences.name: Machh Bari Salt Lake – Sunday Singi Pre-order (Stunned at Harvest)
experiences.description: Our Sunday pre-order for the neighbourhood: 1.5 kg singi from partner farms in Naihati and Barasat, harvested from 5 am Sunday. Each fish is stunned by a blow to the head immediately after harvest and decapitated before dressing; fish are not held alive after harvest. Dressed and cut at the farm into jhol pieces, head pieces included, never frozen, packed in ice-lined crates. Delivered the same morning by our two-wheeler in a 9:00–10:30 am slot; delivery included.

experiences.name: Maniktala Bazaar Runner – Live Singi, Cut at the Stall
experiences.description: Your Sunday bazaar trip, done for you. Our runner shops Maniktala market 6:30–8:30 am Sunday and picks 1.5 kg singi from a vendor's tub, where the fish are held alive in shallow water. The vendor scales and cuts them to order at the stall into jhol-size pieces with head, without prior stunning. Bought the same morning, never frozen; packed in a food-grade bag in an insulated box with ice. Vendor's bill shared on WhatsApp. At your door by 10 am; delivery included.

experiences.name: Koley Market Jhol Sobji Box for 8
experiences.description: Everything for the jhol except the fish: potol, aloo, begun, green chillies, coriander and fresh ginger, portioned for 8. Washed and ready to chop. Sourced from Koley Market wholesale early Sunday and delivered 7–9 am in a reusable cloth bag.

experiences.name: Barasat Pukur Singi – Stunned at Harvest, Same-Morning Jhol Cut
experiences.description: Singi harvested at dawn on Sunday from our own ponds in Barasat, North 24 Parganas. Each fish is electrically stunned in water at the pond side immediately after harvest and killed before dressing; fish are not held alive after harvest. Scaled and cut into jhol-size pieces with head, then on ice at 0–2 °C within 30 minutes. Never frozen. 1.5 kg in an insulated box, delivered 8:30–10:00 am Sunday to Salt Lake; delivery included.

experiences.name: Jyanto Maach Doorstep – Live Singi in Handi, Cut at Your Door
experiences.description: The para fishmonger tradition, brought to your gate. 1.5 kg singi from North 24 Parganas pond farmers, bought at the Sunday wholesale market and carried to you alive in a water-filled aluminium handi (1–2 hours in transit). At your door, our fishmonger cuts them into jhol-size pieces with head on his own boti and board, without prior stunning. Same morning, never frozen. Handi collected back after cutting. Sunday 9–10:30 am slot in Salt Lake; delivery included.

experiences.name: Lake Town Rannaghar – Niramish Sunday Lunch for 8
experiences.description: A Bengali niramish spread for 8, cooked Sunday morning in our Lake Town home kitchen: mochar ghonto, aloo posto and cholar dal, all cooked in mustard oil with no dairy, plus fragrant gobindobhog rice. Delivered hot in sealed steel containers by 12:30 pm, ready to serve.

experiences.name: Grihasthi Helpers – Bengali Home Cook, 4 Hours Sunday
experiences.description: Book an experienced Bengali home cook for 4 hours on Sunday morning. The cook arrives at 8 am and works in your kitchen with your utensils, handling prep, rice, dal and jhol to your family's taste. Ingredients not included; booked through our local household-services agency.
